plan: Drive: from Old Fort Nelson, about 179 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 59.94109, -121.49956, pull off on an unnamed gravel road. Map links below.
Walk: 6.8 km N, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 78 m, about 144 min at 3 km/h.
Camp: flat ground 690 m SE of the spot at 529 m (59.99686, -121.45473). Water: unnamed wetland right here (estimate).
Hunt: moose, Oct, Nov (season rows). Glass the wetland and cutblock edges at dawn and dusk. Move slowly, stop often (Tip).
Use: .308 Winchester, 165 to 180 grain premium bullet, shots inside about 200 m (219 yd) (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 7-55, Region 7B. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-08-05, closures 2026-10-16.
